headline: Both accounts authorized; no broker repair needed
summary: At 21:05 Eastern on October 19, both accounts completed successful prompted keepalives. Independent metadata-only checks then succeeded for both accounts. The broker and watchdog are healthy; no implementation change or restart is warranted.
cause: Authorization: the alert at 21:05:26 captured the prior successful round while the first prompted call was in progress. The prompted calls completed at 21:05:32 and 21:05:36 with exit 0 in 9.52 and 3.90 seconds. The preceding hour of sanitized events shows successful calls without a recorded failure, app lock or relaunch. The exact renewal trigger is unproven. Parser/watchdog: log parsing and persisted state agree that the app is unlocked, the heartbeat advances, no fault episode is active, and deployed hashes/build stamp/signature match. The diagnostic category authorization_or_unknown is not itself failure evidence.
resolution: No candidate patch, implementation change, installation, restart or agent-requested auth wake was needed. Broker PID/session 1213, PTY /dev/ttys000 and keepalive PID 1214 were preserved. Only sanitized incident evidence and a README incident note were added. The first-click gate remains false; a verified no-change settlement is permitted without a click.
verification: Both wrapper vault-list calls returned exit 0 in 1.223 and 1.017 seconds with stdout/stderr discarded. Deployed source hashes, running keepalive hash, build stamp and bundle signature verified. Heartbeat advanced from 21:05:56 to 21:06:16 Eastern with unchanged identities. Two diagnostic Python runs passed all 44 tests, including a run from the original working directory; 37 Node tests passed. The first Python run reported one failure and retained only its aggregate summary; it was not reproduced in either diagnostic run. Chat title, dotfiles cwd, Pinned section and strongest advertised desktop model gpt-6-astra/high were read back. Artifacts preserve all test outcomes.
activation: The existing broker and keepalive remain running. Nothing is staged; no service load or activation command is required.
limitations: Exact authorization-renewal cause and physical consent interaction were not established. No credential content was read and no UI or physical notification-click test was performed. The initial synthetic test failure cannot be attributed because its failing-test details were not retained; two subsequent diagnostic runs were clean, and it does not establish a fault in this successfully completed authorization episode. Deferred archive is confirmed only by its later private receipt; scheduling does not prove archival.
docs: Reviewed src/onepassword/README.md, agent-contract.md and autofixes/AGENTS.md. Added the October 19 evening incident note to README.md. Existing guidance correctly separates successful prompted authorization from parser/watchdog faults; the shared contract and autofix policy remain unchanged, so no guidance synchronization was needed.
